items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Sy and I wrote that together.

ctx.x: Well, "Easy does it". You probably know that (hums a few measures). That's my tune. Sy and I wrote that together. I don't know. I can't -- some -- but a lot of them wasn't -- didn't get popular -- that you wouldn't have really known. Some of them did, you know. But the best -- I think the best thing I ever did was that "Traveling Light". I think it's the best thing I ever did. I didn't write the lyrics for it but I liked the melody.

All the guys that knew I wrote it back -- they loved the melody -- way back, you know. But that's about the best melody that I ever wrote -- that I ever did. Once in a while you can come up with a -- you can't do that -- I can't -- consistently, you know. But once in a while you really strike a haunting melody that appeals to a lot of people, you know.
